name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: An order pad hung from the top of the screen: cream paper with a torn top edge and a binder clip. Rows carry their own line of the pad's ruling, hover is the highlighter, and the current page is marked with a highlighter swipe and a bracket in the margin. It collapses to icons or slides away, becomes a sheet on phones, and stays cheap for a long menu: only the one active row draws anything.

a11y: The sidebar adds no landmark of its own: wrap it in a `nav` (or give it `aria-label` on the Sidebar's container) so screen readers can find it. The rows are ordinary buttons and links in a list; `isActive` on a link (`asChild`) or a sub-menu button sets `aria-current="page"` for you (pass your own to override; a plain button gets none); the drawing is decoration.

Ctrl or Cmd + B toggles it from anywhere; the SidebarTrigger is a labeled button ("Toggle Sidebar"). The rail is not a tab stop. On phones the pad opens in a Sheet: a dialog named "Sidebar" that traps focus, closes with Escape or a tap on the scrim and gives focus back to whatever opened it (Reka UI only does that for its own Trigger, so the Sidebar remembers the opener itself). Growing the window past the phone width closes the sheet, so it does not come back by itself when the window shrinks again. Ctrl/Cmd+B is left alone when something nearer (a rich-text editor's Bold) has already handled the key.

Keyboard focus on a row shows the highlighter and the theme's blue focus ring. Every row is at least 28 px high (32 by default); collapsed rows are 32 px squares, named by their tooltip and their text (keep the label in a `span` so it stays in the accessible name).
When it collapses to icons the labels are hidden with CSS only, so the accessible names stay. Tooltips appear on hover and keyboard focus, never on touch.

The torn edge, ruled lines, binder clip, bracket and sub-menu line are aria-hidden decoration with no pointer events. In forced-colors mode the clip is hidden and the drawings give way to real outlines. Reduced motion collapses the slide of the pad and the fade of the labels.
The open state is remembered in the `sidebar_state` cookie; read it on the server to render the right state on first paint.
